rationale: C06 is a compelling drafting template: both directives concern Hawaii land previously reserved for the Navy, use nearly identical two-WHEREAS predicates, declare the property no longer needed, restore it to the Territory's jurisdiction, and then provide a metes-and-bounds description beginning from a surveyed point and running by true azimuths. C14 and C11 share much of the same restoration machinery, but C06 is closest in wording, sequence, treatment of improvements, and survey-description format.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS certain hereinafter-described lands at Keaukaha, Waiakea, South Hilo, County and Territory of Hawaii, were set aside for the use of the United States Navy Department for military purposes by Executive Order No. 361... of the Governor of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS certain hereinafter-described lands in the District of Hanapepe, County of Kauai, Territory of Hawaii, were reserved for the use of the United States Navy Department as a radio station by Executive Order No. 145... of the Governor of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.explanation: The opening predicate follows the same distinctive structure, substituting the Hawaiian location, gubernatorial order, and particular naval use.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS such lands are no longer needed by the United States Government for military purposes, and it is deemed advisable and in the public interest that they be restored to the jurisdiction of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS such lands and the improvements thereon are no longer needed by the Navy Department for use as a radio station, and it is deemed advisable and in the public interest that they be restored to the use of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.explanation: This is close parallel language establishing non-need and public-interest restoration, adapted only to the factual predicate.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The following-described lands... together with any improvements thereon, are hereby restored to the jurisdiction of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The following-described lands... together with all improvements located thereon, are hereby restored to the jurisdiction of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.explanation: The operative grant uses materially the same restoration formula and expressly transfers accompanying improvements.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Beginning at a pipe at the Southwest corner... the coordinates of said point of beginning referred to Government Survey Trig. Station "Keokea No. 2"... and running by true azimuths
shared_material.parent_excerpt: BEGINNING at a 2-inch pipe at the Northwest corner... the coordinates of said point of beginning referred to Government Survey Trig. Station "Puolo"... and running by true azimuths
shared_material.explanation: Both orders deploy the same concrete survey-description machinery: a pipe monument, coordinates tied to a Government Survey triangulation station and registered map, followed by numbered true-azimuth courses and an area statement.
